description:
🍦 ULTIMATE High Protein KETO Vanilla Cookies & Cream Ice Cream Ninja Creami 🍦

Looking for the creamiest, most indulgent low-carb ice cream that actually tastes like the real deal? In today’s video, I’ll show you how to make high protein, sugar-free Cookies & Cream ice cream — keto-friendly, low-carb, and packed with protein to fuel your goals.

This recipe is perfect for anyone on keto, low carb, or high protein diets who doesn’t want to give up dessert. It’s rich, smooth, and filled with delicious cookie chunks without the sugar crash.

✅ Macros-friendly
✅ Protein-packed
✅ No sugar added
✅ Keto & low-carb approved

⸻

⏱️ Timestamps
0:00 – Intro: Why this is the ultimate keto protein ice cream
0:50 – Ingredients overview (protein powder, cream, keto cookies, sweetener)
2:05 – Mixing the ice cream base
5:46 – Spin and add ins
6:48 – The perfect scoop and reveal 🍦
7:38 – Taste test
8:23 – Outro + next week

⸻

🔑 Keywords / Tags
keto ice cream, high protein ice cream, keto dessert, sugar free ice cream, low carb ice cream, keto cookies and cream, protein dessert, ninja creami keto, healthy ice cream recipe, low carb cookies and cream, keto sweets, keto friendly dessert

⸻

📌 Don’t forget to SUBSCRIBE for more keto-friendly desserts, high protein recipes, and ice cream creations!

comments.text:
I've learned a lot watching him. Some people won't tolerate the texture and need to respin at that middle ground. 

I have had success with ice cream calculator 4. I shoot for 5٪ fat but depending on preference and application (if you're eating the whole tub in one sitting or plan to respin the rest) you can get away with maybe 3%

I'm still learning. I have found other resources like j_hermann site and reddit. 

I mixed two Stabilizer blends into  from j_hermann. For each deluxe tub I would use 20g of this and add more inulin in the recipe. If you're using a protein powder than this all goes way down, maybe skip the sucralose as well.
(I x6 this recipe I don't have a jewel scale also added 1.5 tsp pure sucralose powder i like it way sweeter than what sugar alcohols can do.)
50g inulin

16g CMC, carboxymethyl cellulose

2g tara gum

½g xanthan gum

2g salt

My latest pb and banana ice cream for 2 pints. 
4 roasted bananas peeled and steeped over night
800g skim milk
100g peanut butter
55g skim milk powder
150g allulose
90g peanut butter powder
20g inulin
40g Stabilizer mix with inulin
25g corn syrup
300g whole milk
1 tsp banana extract
Warm to dissolve except the extract
remove from heat, let cool,
Add banana extract and steep bananas in the base over night 
Remove bananas and pour in 2 tubs. Freeze for at least 18 hr, you will have a hump so either smash it down half way or freeze without the lid. 
Light ice cream setting, scrape down sides and respin.

Each tub is ~960 calories. 72 g net carbs 72g protein 40g fat 29g fiber 
Becareful if you're not used to too much fiber and allulose.
For me I really enjoyed it, maybe needed more banana extract since the pb is very strong, or just don't mess with the bananas at all. It's not meant to be a protein or weightloss ice cream but just a healthier choice. You can definitely play with ice cream simulator and get this down to 750 per pint if you replace the whole milk, lower the peanut butter and take out the syrup. You'll be compromising even worse on texture and flavor.

You're looking for recipes that you can add extra solids, chocolates kinda easy. Fruits you'll want to probably stick to extracts. 

I made a brownie batter once with toasted milk powder, brown butter and bloomed cocoa in it and used skim milk since I had fat from the butter.
